门店之间调货 · Transfer stock between stores

24 Xpress App · 全体门店员工、跑腿 · All store staff and runners · App 2026-10-04.146

像大型便利店一样三方交接：送货店打包、数袋、拍照 → 带货的人数袋、按「已取货」 → 收货店先数袋，再点货。哪一段少了，一看就知道。
A three-way handover, the way big convenience chains do it: the sending store packs, counts the bags and takes a photo → the carrier counts the bags and taps Picked up → the receiving store counts the bags first, then the items. If anything goes missing, you can see at which step.
先看这里 · Read first

规矩Rules

  1. 送货的店在 App 开调货单，收货的店在 App 点收。点收后 App 自动在 AutoCount 开调货单，数量按收货店点到的。不用再在 AutoCount 手动打调货单。
    The sending store makes the transfer in the App; the receiving store counts it in the App. After the count, the App creates the AutoCount transfer for the quantities the receiving store counted. No more keying transfers in AutoCount by hand.
  2. 每张调货都要写谁带货、几袋／几箱，还要拍打包好的货。
    Every transfer records who carries it, how many bags / cartons, and a photo of the packed goods.
  3. 送货的人不能自己点收，要由收货店的同事点。收到的不能比送出的多。少了就写实际数量，HQ 会跟进。
    The sender cannot confirm their own transfer; a colleague at the receiving store counts it. You cannot receive more than was sent. If short, enter what arrived; HQ follows up.
  4. 送出超过 24 小时还没收到，HQ 会看到 ⏰。咖啡馆（BR24、BR26）不是调货，继续用「记到咖啡馆」。
    Anything not received 24 hours after sending shows ⏰ to HQ. The cafés (BR24, BR26) are not transfers; keep using "Book to café".
① 打开 · Open

首页 → 门店调货Home → Store transfers

首页「货品与库存」按 门店调货（卡车图标），或按首页的调货卡。
Under Goods & stock on Home, tap Store transfers (the truck), or tap the transfer card on Home.

调货 · Transfers
② 送出 · Send

开调货单、打包、交接Make the transfer, pack, hand over

  1. 按 送货去别间店，选送去哪间店，加货品和数量。
    Tap Send stock to another store, pick the store, add the items and quantities.
  2. 谁带货：我自己送、跑腿、对方店的同事来拿、本店同事，或快递（写快递名字和车牌）。
    Who carries it: me, a runner, a colleague from the other store who collects it, a colleague from my store, or a courier (enter the courier name and plate).
  3. 打包成几袋／几箱，再拍打包好的货（每一袋都要拍到）。
    Enter how many bags / cartons, then photograph the packed goods (every bag in view).
  4. 按 送出。货和调货单号（XF…）一起交给带货的人。
    Tap Send. Hand the goods and the transfer number (XF…) to the carrier.
  5. 送错了？带货的人还没按「已取货」就可以取消；自己送或快递的，送出后 30 分钟内可以取消。之后要找 HQ。
    Sent by mistake? Cancel before the carrier taps Picked up; for self or courier deliveries, within 30 minutes of sending. After that, ask HQ.
送出 · Send
③ 带货 · Carry

带货的人：数袋，按「已取货」The carrier: count the bags, tap Picked up

  1. 被指定带货的人，首页会出现「有 n 张调货要你带过去」。点开 要你带去的货。
    If you are named as the carrier, Home shows "n transfer(s) for you to carry". Open Goods for you to carry.
  2. 在送货的店当面数袋数，写你拿了几袋，按 已取货，再出发。袋数不对，送货店和 HQ 会看到。
    At the sending store, count the bags in front of them, enter how many you took, tap Picked up, then go. If the count differs, the sending store and HQ see it.
取货 · Pick up

带货的人也可以在「门店调货」里看到自己要带的货。
Carriers also see their goods to carry under Store transfers.

要带的货 · To carry
④ 点收 · Receive

先数袋，再点货Count the bags first, then the items

  1. 货到了，打开那张调货单。先数袋数，写收到几袋／几箱。
    When the goods arrive, open the transfer. Count the bags first and enter how many bags / cartons arrived.
  2. 再一样一样点，写实际收到的数量，按 确认收到。App 自动在 AutoCount 开调货单。
    Then count each item, enter what arrived and tap Confirm received. The App creates the AutoCount transfer.
  3. 袋数少了：HQ 去问带货的人。袋数对、货少了：是打包的问题，HQ 去问送货店。
    Bags missing: HQ asks the carrier. All bags there but items short: a packing problem; HQ asks the sending store.
点收 · Receive
⑤ 状态 · Status

一眼看到货在哪里See where the goods are

  • 📦 等某人来取货 · Waiting for someone to pick up
  • 🚚 运送中 · 谁带 · 几袋 · On the way · who · how many bags
  • ✅ AutoCount 已过账 · Posted in AutoCount
  • ⚠ 少了几袋／带货的人没按取货／带货的人自己点收 · bags missing / carrier did not tap Picked up / received by the carrier
  • ⏰ 超过 24 小时没收到 · not received after 24 hours
  • HQ 和送货店可以按 📷 看打包照片。 · HQ and the sending store can tap 📷 to see the packing photo.
状态 · Status
⑥ 看货品 · Check the items

点开任何一张调货，看每样货Open any transfer to see every item

  1. 在调货页，点任何一张调货（「寄给你的」那几张旁边有 🔍 查看货品 按钮；点整行还是进入点收）。
    On the transfer page, tap any transfer (the ones sent to you also have a 🔍 View items button; tapping the whole row still opens the count).
  2. 会看到调货单号、谁送出、状态、几袋，以及每样货的送出数量 → 实收数量。收的数量比送的少，会用红色显示。
    You see the transfer number, who sent it, the status, the bags, and every item with sent → received quantity. A short receive is shown in red.
  3. 这里只看，不会改任何东西。要点收请在「寄给你的」那一张里按点收。
    This is view only; nothing is changed. To count and confirm, open the one sent to you.
